sentences.text:
Vinai Gupta vs Har Nandan Pandey And Another on 12
September, 2019
Author: Sudhir Agarwal

Bench: Sudhir Agarwal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 34
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1055 of 1995
Revisionist :- Vinai Gupta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- Har Nandan Pandey And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Janardan Sahai,Vindo Kumar Kushwaha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
Called in revise.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgments and orders dated 19.01.1991 and 26.08.1995.

The Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-III, Shahjahanpur vide order dated 19.01.1991 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.1,000/- under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 06 of 1991 before the Court of Ist Additional Sessions Judge, Shahjahanpur (hereinafter referred to as "Appellate Court") and Appellate Court vide order dated 26.08.1995 dismissed appeal and confirmed judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by Trial Court.

entities.text: Court of Ist Additional Sessions Judge, Shahjahanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Being aggrieved

,
present Revision has been preferred by revisionist.

sentences.text:
Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.

4. Dismissed.
5.
The revisionist is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shahjahanpur shall cause him to be arrested and lodged in jail to serve out sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be reported within two months.
6. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.

Order Date :- 12.9.2019 Ashish Pd.
